title: ShySlimes
description: makes slimes only spawn where it's dark within slime chunks
body:
This mod restricts slime spawns further to only happen at lightlevels lower than 8 like other hostile mobs. They still only spawn in slime chunks below y-level 16. Over are the days where you have to avoid slime chunks when building underground, to avoid being overrun with slimes. Now you can light everything up and be save from all monsters spawning. :)

This is my third mod and it is super simple. I hope you like it ^^
